Columns by ancestry

An opening paragraph in the single column of the page. It is measured as usual, and it keeps the section below high enough on the first page for the cross-check to sample its boxes.

A heading across both columns

This paragraph runs long enough to be set over many lines in the narrow measure of one column, so the column break falls inside it and the second column opens with its tail. Its own column count is auto, like every paragraph here; only its container asks for two columns, and the columns are where its lines are set.

A small boxed note that asks not to be broken, set inside the columns.

A closing paragraph inside the container balances the two columns with a few more lines of ordinary running text.

Margin note printed beside the text.

This container sets only a column width. Its column count stays auto, yet the browser fits as many columns of that width as the measure allows, and this paragraph is set in them.

A final paragraph back in the single column of the page, measured as usual.
